name: Clark Fork River (Missoula)
blurb: Float straight through downtown Missoula and wave at Brennan's Wave surfers.

sections.notes: Caras Terrace provides walk-in river access with stairs and a path. It is not a trailer boat ramp. Scout a suitable exit before launching, especially with a large raft; Brennan’s Wave is a nearby whitewater feature. The map shows the project area, not an exact landing.
sections.distanceReview: Caras Terrace access is documented, but the legacy 6-mile distance has not been reconciled with the completed walk-in exit. Distance and float-time estimates remain withheld pending a reviewed river measurement.

notices.title: Walk-in exit at Caras Terrace
notices.text: The City of Missoula completed the Caras Terrace river-access improvements in 2025. Use the designated stairs and paths; confirm the exit suits your craft before launching.
notices.sourceName: City of Missoula — Caras Terrace completion update and river-access permit

sections.notes: Diversion dam, braided channels and in-stream obstacles downstream of Missoula. This route is under review; no float-time estimate is provided.
sections.accessReview: Do not use this listing to plan a casual float. Missoula identifies Silver Park as the last public exit before the downstream Grass Valley diversion dam, with Kelly Island below the dam. A suitable route and access plan have not been established.

notices.title: Downstream diversion dam
notices.text: The City of Missoula recommends taking out at Silver Park before the downstream diversion dam. Kelly Island is below that dam.
notices.sourceName: City of Missoula — Silver Park Boat Landing
